Metrics","metadata":{}},{"id":"36bf4a76","cell_type":"code","source":"def make_prepare_train(tokenizer):\n    pad_right = tokenizer.padding_side == \"right\"\n    def prepare_train_features(examples):\n        questions = [q.lstrip() for q in examples[\"question\"]]\n        tok = tokenizer(questions, examples[\"context\"],\n                        truncation=\"only_second\", max_length=MAX_LENGTH, stride=DOC_STRIDE,\n                        return_overflowing_tokens=True, return_offsets_mapping=True,\n                        padding=\"max_length\")\n        sample_map = tok.pop(\"overflow_to_sample_mapping\")\n        offset_map = tok.pop(\"offset_mapping\")\n        tok[\"start_positions\"], tok[\"end_positions\"] = [], []\n        for i, offsets in enumerate(offset_map):\n            input_ids = tok[\"input_ids\"][i]\n            cls_index = input_ids.index(tokenizer.cls_token_id)\n            seq_ids = tok.sequence_ids(i)\n            answers = examples[\"answers\"][sample_map[i]]\n            start_char = answers[\"answer_start\"][0]\n            end_char = start_char + len(answers[\"text\"][0])\n            ts = 0\n            while seq_ids[ts] != 1: ts += 1\n            te = len(input_ids) - 1\n            while seq_ids[te] != 1: te -= 1\n            if not (offsets[ts][0] <= start_char and offsets[te][1] >= end_char):\n                tok[\"start_positions\"].append(cls_index); tok[\"end_positions\"].append(cls_index)\n            else:\n                while ts < len(offsets) and offsets[ts][0] <= start_char: ts += 1\n                tok[\"start_positions\"].append(ts - 1)\n                while offsets[te][1] >= end_char: te -= 1\n                tok[\"end_positions\"].append(te + 1)\n        return tok\n    return prepare_train_features\n\ndef make_prepare_val(tokenizer):\n    def prepare_validation_features(examples):\n        questions = [q.lstrip() for q in examples[\"question\"]]\n        tok = tokenizer(questions, examples[\"context\"],\n                        truncation=\"only_second\", max_length=MAX_LENGTH, stride=DOC_STRIDE,\n                        return_overflowing_tokens=True, return_offsets_mapping=True,\n                        padding=\"max_length\")\n        sample_map = tok.pop(\"overflow_to_sample_mapping\")\n        tok[\"example_id\"] = []\n        for i in range(len(tok[\"input_ids\"])):\n            seq_ids = tok.sequence_ids(i)\n            tok[\"example_id\"].append(examples[\"id\"][sample_map[i]])\n            tok[\"offset_mapping\"][i] = [o if seq_ids[k] == 1 else None\n                                        for k, o in enumerate(tok[\"offset_mapping\"][i])]\n        return tok\n    return prepare_validation_features\n\n\ndef postprocess_predictions(examples, features, raw_preds, n_best=20, max_answer_len=30):\n    start_logits, end_logits = raw_preds\n    ex_to_feats = collections.defaultdict(list)\n    id_to_idx = {k: i for i, k in enumerate(examples[\"id\"])}\n    for i, f in enumerate(features):\n        ex_to_feats[id_to_idx[f[\"example_id\"]]].append(i)\n\n    predictions = collections.OrderedDict()\n    for ex_i, ex in enumerate(examples):\n        context, best = ex[\"context\"], None\n        for fi in ex_to_feats[ex_i]:\n            s_log, e_log = start_logits[fi], end_logits[fi]\n            offsets = features[fi][\"offset_mapping\"]\n            for s in np.argsort(s_log)[-1:-n_best-1:-1].tolist():\n                for e in np.argsort(e_log)[-1:-n_best-1:-1].tolist():\n                    if (s >= len(offsets) or e >= len(offsets) or offsets[s] is None\n                            or offsets[e] is None or e < s or e - s + 1 > max_answer_len):\n                        continue\n                    score = s_log[s] + e_log[e]\n                    if best is None or score > best[0]:\n                        best = (score, context[offsets[s][0]:offsets[e][1]])\n        predictions[ex[\"id\"]] = best[1] if best else \"\"\n    return predictions\n\n\n# ---- SQuAD official-style metrics (EM / F1) ----\ndef normalize_answer(s):\n    s = s.lower()\n    s = \"\".join(ch for ch in s if ch not in set(string.punctuation))\n    s = re.sub(r\"\\b(a|an|the)\\b\", \" \", s)\n    return \" \".join(s.split())\n\ndef f1_score(pred, truth):\n    p, t = normalize_answer(pred).split(), normalize_answer(truth).split()\n    common = collections.Counter(p) & collections.Counter(t)\n    n_same = sum(common.values())\n    if len(p) == 0 or len(t) == 0: return float(p == t)\n    if n_same == 0: return 0.0\n    prec, rec = n_same / len(p), n_same / len(t)\n    return 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec)\n\ndef exact_match(pred, truth):\n    return float(normalize_answer(pred) == normalize_answer(truth))\n\ndef squad_metrics(predictions, examples):\n    em = f1 = 0.0\n    for ex in examples:\n        pred = predictions[ex[\"id\"]]\n        truths = ex[\"answers\"][\"text\"]\n        em += max(exact_match(pred, t) for t in truths)\n        f1 += max(f1_score(pred, t) for t in truths)\n    n = len(examples)\n    return {\"exact_match\": 100 * em / n, \"f1\": 100 * f1 / n}","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-27T00:36:45.751169Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-27T00:36:45.751944Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-27T00:36:45.770648Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-27T00:36:45.751907Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-27T00:36:45.769915Z"}},"outputs":[],"execution_count":6},{"id":"887574a6","cell_type":"markdown","source":"##          epochs=EPOCHS, lr=LR, bs=BATCH_SIZE):\n    print(f\"\\n{'='*20} {model_name} {'='*20}\")\n    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)\n    model = AutoModelForQuestionAnswering.from_pretrained(model_name)\n\n    train_feats = train_ds.map(make_prepare_train(tokenizer), batched=True,\n desc=\"tokenize val\")\n\n    steps_per_epoch = -(-len(train_feats) // bs)\n    warmup_steps = int(0.1 * steps_per_epoch * epochs)   # 10% warmup (يشتغل مع كل إصدارات transformers)\n\n    args = TrainingArguments(\n        output_dir=f\"{OUT_DIR}/ckpt_{model_name.split('/')[-1]}\",\n        learning_rate=lr, num_train_epochs=epochs,\n        per_device_train_batch_size=bs, seed=SEED,\n    )\n    try:   # transformers >= 4.46 / 5.x\n        trainer = Trainer(model=model, args=args, train_dataset=train_feats,\n                          data_collator=default_data_collator, data_collator=default_data_collator, tokenizer=tokenizer)\n\n    t0 = time.time()\n    trainer.train()\n    train_time = time.time() - t0\n\n    raw = trainer.predict(val_feats.remove_columns([\"example_id\", \"offset_mapping\"]))\n    preds = postprocess_predictions(dev_ds, val_feats, raw.predictions)\n    metrics = squad_metrics(preds, dev_ds)\n    metrics.update({\"model\": model_name, \"train_time_min\": round(train_time / 60, 1)})\n    print(metrics)\n\n    if save_dir:\n        trainer.save_model(save_dir); tokenizer.save_pretrained(save_dir)\n        print(\"Saved to\", save_dir)\n    return trainer, tokenizer, metrics,
